fields.title: Narrate's band gets BAND-ALIGN-2 R7's fixed band and leading space
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-30 by roadmap review 2026-10-30. Owner design ruling 2026-10-30: R7 ('Add space, band fixed') covers Flow and Focus only; Narrate's band (src/reader/modes/narrate/mode.css, placed at FLOW_ZONE_INITIAL_TOP) gets the same treatment as a separate item, in Narrate's own runtime (no sibling imports). Includes the owner's R7 sub-rulings: band fixed at both section ends, no leading space on zero-word sections, a few px shift on headings acceptable.
